mentions.note: walker, born 1903, joined Belgrave in the 1920s; won the Horwood Cup several times; scored for Surrey in 1948 Inter-Counties Road Walking Championship (tied first with Middlesex); Walking Vice-Captain of Veterans A.C.; died 1977

share.d: A. H. 'Bert' East in The Belgravian, the Belgrave Harriers club gazette, 1977: 1 mention in 1 issue.
